claim: On Windows, editable GUI scripts use the console-script wrapper and python.exe instead of the windowed launcher.

findings.claim: On Windows, editable GUI scripts use the console-script wrapper and python.exe instead of the windowed launcher.

evidence_receipt.claim: On Windows, editable GUI scripts use the console-script wrapper and python.exe instead of the windowed launcher.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: If the code created separate console/gui wrappers or used pythonw.exe for gui scripts distinctly, claim would be contradicted; here all scripts (console and gui) are treated identically with the same .cmd wrapper and self._env.python, showing no distinct windowed launcher handling exists at all, contradicting the claim's implication that a windowed launcher normally exists but is bypassed.
